Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem set for Frontend Engineer interview — next steps

Hi Owen,

Thanks again for speaking with the team last week — we enjoyed the conversation. As discussed, attached is the take-home problem set for the Frontend Engineer role. A few quick notes: 

- Deadline: 72 hours from receipt (Mon, Sep 22 09:12 PDT). If you need more time, please tell us and we'll accommodate.
- Deliverables: a short write-up (markdown or PDF) and the code in the attached solution-template.ipynb or a GitHub repo link.
- Do not worry about heavy styling; focus on clarity, tests, and reasoning for trade-offs.

Attachments: RS-frontend-problemset.pdf (PDF, ~1.1MB), solution-template.ipynb (notebook)

Can you reply to confirm you received this and that the deadline works?

Thanks,

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Owen Chan <owen.chan@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem set for Frontend Engineer — next steps

Hi Owen —

Thanks for the quick reply and good question. You can use component libraries for common UI bits (buttons, inputs) but please avoid heavy abstractions that hide implementation decisions (so no complete design-system copy). We want to see how you organize state, structure components, and reason about performance. If you use MUI or similar, include short notes in the write-up about any trade-offs.

Also, small update on reviewer logistics so you know what to expect on submission: 

- Reviewer rotation: Marissa will review submissions arriving within the first 24 hours of the deadline window; Jonas will take the next batch.
- If the candidate requests an extension or flags availability issues, we'll adjust pairing and may bring Aditya in for tie-break. 
- Review rubric highlights: correctness, clarity of reasoning, minimal tests, architecture rationale.

If that all sounds good I'll mark the candidate as "in-flight" in the tracker and set review slots.

Best,
Sofia

Marissa / Jonas — looping you both in to confirm reviewer coverage for Owen Chan's submission. Owen confirmed receipt and intends to submit within the 72-hr window (by Tue 09:12 PDT). Plan below: 

- Marissa: please take submissions that arrive by Mon 09:12 PDT (first 24h). Aim to complete first-pass review within 36 hours of receipt.
- Jonas: take submissions arriving after that up until the deadline; please finish reviews within 36 hours as well.
- If either of you foresee capacity conflicts, flag here and we'll reassign — Aditya is on standby as a tie-break reviewer.

Also attaching a quick rubric excerpt to standardize feedback. (Rubric: focus on requirements, edge-case handling, test coverage, explanation clarity.)

Attachments: review-rubric.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Sofia
